summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, resolve multiple deployment pipeline issues (Grafana provisioning, desktop app signing), update outdated codebase documentation, and clean up stale debug sessions and worktrees.
summary.outcome: Fixed vault recovery E2E test via protobuf field bug + IPNS resolution order fix (PR #369), resolved Grafana API key expiry and desktop build signing key wiring (PR #370), updated all 7 codebase docs for multi-package architecture, cleaned up worktrees and stale debug session. A new writable-shares E2E flakiness fix was started but the transcript ends mid-commit.

repo: IPNS protobuf records store the value (CID path) at field number 1, not field 2 — field 2 is signatureV1. Any protobuf parsing of IPNS records must check fieldNumber === 1.

resolveIpns() tried IPFS gateway HEAD first (15s timeout) before delegated routing — in CI, Kubo can't resolve mock-published IPNS names, so every resolution wasted 15s. Delegated routing should always be tried first.

recovery.html's vault key blob fetch used a direct /ipns/ gateway path (30s timeout) before resolveIpns() — in CI this caused the full 30s hang before fallback, matching the test timeout and causing failures.
mock-ipns-routing stores IPNS records correctly; the failure was in the parsing layer in recovery.html, not in the routing service.
Desktop Tauri builds require TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY env var wired into the tauri-action step — the pubkey was added to tauri.conf.json but the workflow wasn't updated to pass the private key.
Grafana Cloud's /api/health returns 404 (not 401/403) when an expired/invalid service account token is used — misleading error that looks like a URL problem.

TextEditorDialog.tsx handleSave has a stale closure issue: if isDirty is false in the closure when Ctrl+S fires, the save is silently skipped. The writable-shares E2E test needs to wait for a 'modified' indicator before pressing Ctrl+S.

The codebase has evolved to a multi-package TypeScript monorepo (packages/sdk, packages/sdk-core, packages/core, packages/crypto, packages/api-client) plus Rust crates — the .planning/codebase docs were still describing the early PoC architecture.

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord() was checking fieldNumber === 2 for the IPNS value, but protobuf field 1 is the value and field 2 is signatureV1. All IPNS resolution silently failed because the CID was never extracted.
Delegated routing fetch retry logic only caught thrown errors, not non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx). Fixed by adding !resp.ok check before the retry sleep.
After resp.json() consumed the response body, the code fell through to resp.arrayBuffer() which would always fail. Fixed by wrapping protobuf parse in an else branch.
Test timeout was 90s but assertion timeout defaulted to 60s — assertion could time out before the test timeout. Fixed with a shared RECOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS constant.
Test 10.3 fails in CI because textarea.fill() doesn't wait for React to update isDirty state before Ctrl+S fires — need to wait for modified indicator after fill before pressing save.

workflow: When a CI test times out at exactly the timeout threshold, the root cause is often a slow path being tried first rather than a code logic error — check for ordering of fallbacks with long timeouts.
Grafana Cloud dashboard provisioning needs a service account token (not a data source API key like Loki/Prometheus keys) — these are fundamentally different credentials for different API surfaces.

GitHub secrets at repo level vs environment level: repo secrets are accessible to all environments, environment secrets are scoped. Choosing repo-level for cross-environment keys like signing keys is correct.
For React state flakiness in E2E tests, waiting for a visible DOM indicator of state change (e.g., 'modified' badge) is more reliable than arbitrary waits after user input.

When cleaning up worktrees before marking a debug session as resolved, verify the debug session's reproduction environment still exists — stale worktree debug sessions should be resolved as 'fixed or stale' rather than continued.

friction: The Grafana 404 error is misleading — it looks like a wrong URL but is actually an auth failure. The error message in the workflow should distinguish auth failures from routing failures.
TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY was already configured as a repo secret but wasn't documented anywhere as needing to be wired into the workflow — discovered only when a build failed.
Worktree cleanup required force-removal because one had already been deleted from disk but its reference was still registered — `git worktree prune` was needed as a separate step.
markdownlint hook blocked the codebase docs commit due to bare code fences and emphasis-as-heading issues in agent-generated content — required manual sed fixups across multiple files.

The writable-shares E2E flakiness is a React stale closure issue that only manifests in CI (timing sensitive) — hard to reproduce locally and required reading the TextEditorDialog source to understand.
open_items: Writable-shares E2E fix (stale closure / Ctrl+S timing) was committed mid-transcript — CI still needs to confirm it passes.
PR #370 (Tauri signing keys) was created but not merged — needs review and merge before next staging deploy.
Milestone v1.1 completion (`/gsd:complete-milestone`) was identified as the next step but not yet executed.
6 pending todos flagged in the GSD system — not reviewed or addressed during this session.
docs/milestone-v1.1-completion branch has 2 commits but no PR was created — needs to be pushed and merged.
The `isDirty` stale closure in TextEditorDialog.tsx may affect more than just the E2E test — could silently drop saves in the real app under rapid interaction.
